test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "destroyed."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word **"destroyed"** is fitting for the blank because it conveys a sense of significant and irreversible harm to the beauty and balance of the natural world.
 
• **"Destroyed"** means to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
 
• By using **"destroyed,"** the sentence emphasizes a severe negative impact, suggesting that the actions of displacing the tribes led to the degradation or ruin of the environment.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

Colonialism had a great impact on the lives of the aboriginal Australians who were eventually subjugated__ by the whites with all power and privilege. The colonisers turned their land into rubbish pits and __construction__ sites for their own betterment. The aborigines were often __perceived__ as sub-humans with low status and dirty habits. The whites not only displaced the tribes off their homeland but also __**destroyed**__ the beauty and balance of the natural world. An increase in deforestation and destruction of traditional land led ______ (5) ______ like emu, eagle, and kangaroo, among many others to dwindle over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Climbed: **to move up towards the top of something. ((पेड़, पहाड़ आदि पर) चढ़ना)
 
• **Utilized: **to make use of something. (किसी वस्‍तु को काम में लाना, (का) उपयोग करना)
 
• **Fed:** to give food to a person or an animal. ((मनुष्‍य या पशु को) खिलाना, भोजन देना)
